fix(codeon): treat live Cursor inspect/recover gaps as running

Cursor inspect StateUnavailable and recover Unknown opened
runtime_outcome_unknown while a just-started Cursor session was still
live. Owner retry then inspect-too-soon again, parking FWN-1.

Defer inspect when the session is not yet retained, skip recover while
inspect holds the session, and classify a retained live session without
prompt events as Running instead of RecoveryRequired.
